title: Portuguese Tagine Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew inspired by the flavors of Portugal, made with chicken, freekeh, and tagine spices.

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets or online

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the freekeh and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the zesty lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with crunchy chopped almonds if desired.
